newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products track higher, degree of tightness.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products track higher, degree of tightness.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were all broadly firmer on Friday as markets dectected some tightness across the barrel, traders said.
Gas oil prices were steady to firmer with tighter supplies of diesel and demand for heating oil supportive.
Russian 0.2 sulphur cargoes continued to be soaked up by demand from the East Med leaving most offers fob Black Sea related with few cargoes left on the water.
Traders said demand from taly and Spain for diesel helped widen the heat/diesel differential slightly but refiners were still reluctant to boost output of more expensive EN590 diesel.

Prompt 0.2 sulphur cargoes were offered around cif high quotes +$3.75 to +$4 cif Med, but traders said buyers were scarce at this level with second half avails looking cheaper after trade around cif high +$2.50 cif Med on Thursday.
Prompt diesel cargoes were offered around $164 cif Med.
High sulphur fuel oil premiums rose with buying continuing but low avails to meet that after some refiners have cut runs.
A major refiner said it sold a 15,000 cargo of high sulphur cracked at floating price above high fob quote +$2. The cargo is co-loading with a 25kt parcel sold more than a weak ago.

"We still have requests for cargoes but we don't have that many avails. With refining margins so poor we cut runs twice this month, so the avails of all products are lower and hence premiums are higher," a trader with the refiner said.
"We can not guarantee cargoes of 20,000 tonnes or more, may be only 15,000-tonne cargoes," he added.
One percent ended the week quietly but traders said premiums were also stronger on a combination of demand and low avails.
Gasoline was up to $1 stronger taking a lead from gains in NWE and firmer NYMEX. Talk that Nigeria was still suffering fuel shortages gave market bulls something to hold onto.
